title: School Garden Opens Its Gates
transcript: A primary school in Brampton is opening its vegetable garden to neighbours on Sunday mornings. The garden was started by teachers three years ago as a way to teach children about where their food comes from. Visitors can help with watering and pick some vegetables to take home. Children must come with an adult, and all visitors should wear closed shoes. A local gardening group has offered to provide tools and show new volunteers how to use them.

questions.prompt: Why was the garden originally created?
options: To make money for school trips.
To supply food to nearby shops.
To teach pupils how food is grown.
To prepare for a gardening competition.
questions.answer: To teach pupils how food is grown.
questions.explanation: 原文说创办花园是为了教孩子食物从哪里来。

questions.prompt: What will the local gardening group do?
questions.explanation: 园艺小组会提供工具，并教新志愿者如何使用。
